project.name: Orbit
project.description: A team task app. Six weeks of history seeded for the ProjectBrain demo.

messages.author: Priya
messages.text: Starting on live board updates. Going to try WebSockets straight from our serverless functions.
messages.label: attempt_start

messages.author: Priya
messages.text: Tried WebSockets on the serverless functions for 2 days. Connections drop at the 10s timeout, see log. Switching to SSE.
messages.label: attempt_result

messages.author: Marco
messages.text: Postgres LIKE search is 2.4s p95 on 200k tasks, benchmark attached. Moving search to Atlas Search.
messages.label: attempt_result

messages.author: Dana
messages.text: Dropping the PDF export library, AGPL licence is a no for us. Lost about 6 hours on it.
messages.label: attempt_result

messages.author: Sam
messages.text: Cheapest model for ticket summaries only hit 61% on our eval set. Not shipping that.
messages.label: attempt_result

messages.author: Priya
messages.text: Decision: the realtime service moves to AWS App Runner as a long-running container.
messages.label: decision

attempts.goal: Live task board updates for everyone on the team
attempts.approach: WebSockets (socket.io) served directly from serverless functions

blockers.detail: Serverless functions time out after 10 seconds, which drops every open WebSocket connection.

conditions.description: Realtime runs on a long-running service instead of serverless functions
A managed pub/sub provider handles the connections

attempts.approach: Postgres LIKE queries over task titles and descriptions

blockers.detail: LIKE with leading wildcards cannot use an index; p95 was 2.4s on 200k tasks.
The AGPL licence would require releasing Orbit's source code.

conditions.description: The library is offered under a commercial or permissive licence

attempts.approach: The cheapest available language model for ticket summarisation

blockers.detail: Only 61 percent of summaries were judged accurate on the team eval set.

conditions.description: A cheap model reaches 85 percent on the same eval set

decisions.title: Use server sessions for auth
decisions.rationale: Simplest option for the first prototype.

decisions.title: Switch auth to JWT
decisions.rationale: Stateless tokens for the serverless API.

decisions.title: Use Better Auth sessions
decisions.rationale: JWT revocation was painful; Better Auth gives revocable sessions with little code.

decisions.title: Use Server-Sent Events for live board updates
decisions.rationale: Works inside the serverless timeout with reconnects.

decisions.title: Use Atlas Search for task search
decisions.rationale: Indexed full-text search with fuzzy matching; p95 under 80ms in the same benchmark.

decisions.title: Move the realtime service to AWS App Runner
decisions.rationale: A long-running container for realtime traffic.

edges.explanation: Realtime now runs on a long-running App Runner service, so the serverless function timeout no longer applies.

prompts.classify: Label the message as decision, attempt_start, attempt_result, intent, question, or noise. Reply with the label only.
prompts.extract: Extract the attempt or decision described. Use only facts stated in the messages. Blocker types: technical_limit, cost, performance, library_bug, licensing, org_constraint, time.
prompts.judge: Given a new plan and a past failed attempt, decide whether the plan would hit the same blocker. If the plan meets one of the attempt's conditions, it is not a match. Reply with match, confidence 0-1, and a one-sentence reason.
prompts.answer: Answer from the cited records only. Say which decisions are current and which are superseded. If the records do not answer the question, say so.
prompts.conditions: Given a new decision and a past attempt's conditions, decide which conditions the decision satisfies.
